executions.claim: Every ngram_width in ngram_widths_ must be > 0 before any further execution.

If splits_vec_size > 0, then splits_vec(0) == 0, and for each i in [1, splits_vec_size), prev_split <= splits_vec(i) <= input_data_size, with prev_split updated to splits_vec(i); after the loop, prev_split == input_data_size.
If data size is 0 or splits_vec size is 0, execution returns after writing zeros to ngrams_splits_data[0..num_batch_items].

Continuing past the empty-data return implies data size > 0 and splits_vec size > 0, and for i in [1, num_batch_items], ngrams_splits_data[i] = ngrams_splits_data[i-1] + num_ngrams where num_ngrams is computed from splits_vec(i)-splits_vec(i-1) and ngram_widths_.

For i in [0, num_batch_items), data_start points to input_data[splits_vec(i)], output_start_idx starts at ngrams_splits_data[i], and for each ngram_width, output_start points to ngrams_data[output_start_idx] and output_start_idx is incremented by get_num_ngrams(splits_vec(i+1)-splits_vec(i), ngram_width).

If preserve_short_ and output_start_idx == ngrams_splits_data[i], then data_length == 0 causes continue; otherwise pad_width_ >= 0 is required, ngram_width = data_length + 2*pad_width_, and one ngram is created at ngrams_data[output_start_idx].
